correctness.rationale: Diagonal monomial moments of C_lambda are lambda^k. For T_f with bounded symbol, angular radial mean h(t) is bounded, and F(z)=int_0^infty h(t)e^{-(1-z)t}dt is holomorphic on Re z<1, equals sum_j c_j/(1-lambda_j z) for |z|<1. Distinct nonzero lambda yield distinct nonremovable poles; holomorphy forces Re(1/lambda)>=1 equivalent Re lambda>=|lambda|², and F(-R)->0 eliminates nonzero coefficient of lambda=0. Conversely f_lambda=lambda^-1 exp[(1-lambda^-1)|z|²] is bounded exactly under condition and its Gaussian monomial moments equal lambda^k; uniqueness follows Gaussian Berezin convolution injectivity on tempered distributions. For lambda=r e^{i theta}, 0<r<1, all nonzero polynomial coefficient powers require cos(n theta)>=r^n. Irrational theta equidistributes giving eligible density 1/2; rational theta=2pi p/q gives density (1+2floor((q-1)/4))/q by residues with strictly positive cosine. For q<=4 only multiples of q eligible, so algebra closure; for q>=5 or irrational find infinitely many n with cos(n theta)>0 and cos(2n theta)<=0, so admissible C_lambda^n has inadmissible square. Independently enumerated reduced rational residues for q=1..100, counting densities and witnessing lack of closure q>=5; checked analytic pole locations and formula algebraically, finite residue tests are corroboration only.
